title: Why Can't You Lift Your RING FINGER? 💍
description:
Hand flat, fold your middle finger under, now lift your ring finger. Stuck? Your fingers are lifted by cords on the back of your hand. Your pointer and your pinky each get a spare lifting muscle of their own; your ring finger only has the shared one, and a little strap ties its cord to the middle finger's. Fold the middle finger down and the strap holds the ring finger down with it. Could you lift it?

In the 1880s a surgeon in Philadelphia cut those straps for pianists, on purpose, to free the ring finger (the operation was controversial, and it fell out of favour).
